name: Does a 'Cancel Anytime Listing Agreement' affect the commission paid upon sale?

mainEntity.name: Does a 'Cancel Anytime Listing Agreement' affect the commission paid upon sale?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, a 'Cancel Anytime Listing Agreement' typically does not alter the commission structure agreed upon if your property sells while the agreement is active. The commission rate is a separate term negotiated within the listing contract. The 'cancel anytime' clause only addresses the termination flexibility, not the financial terms if a successful sale occurs. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution maintains transparent commission rates, which are clearly outlined in your agreement.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, it does not affect the commission rate; the commission structure is negotiated separately and applies if the property sells during the agreement.
